queries.purpose: Read the stored ColorLok setting through the default-setting interface.
queries.control_flow_proof: A03DB960 parses one integer and calls settings-interface slot8. Physical60 identifies object2084A0B4, and physical64 proves its header: vtableA06073EC, table2084A0C0, count51. Exact indices1/3/4 are bounded. Slot8 A03CE8E0 reads the record DSID at table+12*index and calls storage-interface slot8. Physical68 resolves20DA30DC toA0517544; physical59 proves its vtableA0517548 and slot8 A005C38C. That helper searches the in-memory DS2 hash chain and returns the scalar; no setter or physical peripheral call. Earlier direct NVM and DS2 observations establish valid nonzero values for these three DSIDs. The CLI has only a three-byte buffer for "%01d;"; the expected single-digit values fit and the captured response must be checked for a complete delimiter and agreement.
queries.side_effects: Parser bookkeeping, local output buffers and UART output.

queries.name: pen.get_printer_build_date
queries.purpose: Read the printer build-date scalar used by the pen subsystem.
queries.control_flow_proof: A032B2B8 callsA03237B6 and prints its scalar through the standard CLI integer formatter. A0323776 first callsA00089DE. Its gateA0008924 reads20004894; physical60 proves initialized flag1, so it skips initialization. A0008938 performs the previously reviewed software hash/compare on boot RAM. If overrides are permitted, only the fixed scalar DSID0x13FC3 is read usingA03211B4 (bounded current-task cache, otherwise storage getter); there is no transaction unlock or write path. Earlier DS2 returned0 for that override, which is retained as raw evidence because zero alone is ambiguous. When no nonzero override is returned, A03237B6 reads20D02D94. Physical68 proves it is nonzero20180624, so the fallback-provider call and cache write are skipped on the observed state. For completeness the fallback objectA05C5154 has slot12 A02D16AE, a fixedDSID0x13042 scalar read. Earlier direct NVM and DS2 returned the same20180624 for DSID_MFG_DATE_EPOCH. No motors, ink, scanner lighting, setting changes or persistent writes are invoked.
queries.side_effects: Local buffers and UART output. The observed nonzero cache bypasses the fallback cache write; initialized security gate bypasses its volatile initialization.
